title: Does diagnostic feedback help a gripper design loop once the task has headroom?
summary: Re-runs the codesign-diagnose ablation after fixing the scene generator that codesign-ceiling blamed for the 0.85 plateau (hand height capped at the object’s centre). Three rule-based readers (score only, failure summary, full rollout logs) and random search, CMA-ES and Bayesian optimisation, 8 seeds × 40 designs in MuJoCo. Every method gains only 0.00–0.05 (median best test success 0.85–0.90) and the ranking is not resolved at 40 test scenes (standard error about 0.05); feedback still does not beat blind search, and the best designs still lose 0.05–0.06 on fresh scenes. Stylised; readers are rules, not an LLM.
